root_semantic_findings: Default new uses process collection; explicit collection construction is independent and unleased; Context factory checks Active before lease family creation and after session creation, returns owned session rather than borrowing context. Clone shares optional lease family/collection Arc, copies cache/report/budgets/mode, creates a fresh rich parser; equality deliberately excludes parser and lease.

Frame begin resets reports/work while retaining cache entries; finish hands Copy table statistics to collection entry and trims shaped cache, leaving owner report until next begin. Cache clear has its own cache report effects and does not act as frame boundary.

Geometry/work budget getters copy snapshots; geometry rejection and fallback are separate observations. Work miss is counted before backend success, including failed/deferred requests, while hits avoid repeated miss work.

Synchronous requests normalize before lookup; Ready diagnostics merge before generation admission, and mismatched retired result is Deferred rather than inserted. Service bounds retries to2, checks generation before/after projection, and snapshots retain old database Arc without freezing future collection publication.

Prewarm preserves each paragraph vertical_mode, uses explicit owned collection, and merges work/shaping receipts. Root corrected only task-added doc401 by deleting the unsupported horizontal qualification; six bytes removed from new prose, no original bytes removed.

Vertical scope saves Option mode and exclusively borrows session; Deref/DerefMut route to it and Drop restores mode on early returns. Only trait horizontal-with-kerning branch redirects; inherent horizontal range is not redirected. Real plain/rich vertical callers verified, no direct scope test among21.

Hard-line keyed path compares source Arc or exact source despite owner/revision contract, returns ordinal window as source offsets and may bypass retention under capacity/estimated bytes. Cloned cache vectors and entries are owned while source Arc references can remain shared.

Twenty-one tests and81assertions reviewed statically; constructed failure/alternate-backend receipts and artifact_query test name do not prove concurrent reload, actual fallback recovery, complete artifact query or UI publication. No Rust/Cargo/benchmark execution.
